title: Native color construction does not publish partial state
goal: A failed native color-configuration replacement keeps the prior complete configuration and releases its candidate, and retry cannot accept partial state as a cache hit.

criteria.text: Working-state, either pipeline/blend, snippet and uniform-discovery failures leave every published configuration value unchanged, with an Error; successful construction publishes the whole candidate.

Every failed/successful candidate balances its state, pipeline, snippet, context and Cogl error ownership; color-only teardown is idempotent and leaves scene resources intact, including aliased state inputs.
Retry after failed first construction rebuilds and publishes complete pipelines and adjustment uniforms rather than hitting partial nonNULL state.
A complete unchanged configuration is reused, but changing target, input working-color state or Cogl context invalidates it.
Existing HDR working-luminance construction, nonparametric target branch, forward/reverse transform direction and flags, and first-use gamma/saturation sentinels are retained.
NULL target, input working-color state or Cogl context returns an Error without altering a complete configuration or reference ownership.

out_of_scope: GNOME51 API/ABI port and compatibility guard changes
Real GObject/Cogl ABI, LUT/curve uploads, native pixels, GI or Shell/deployment acceptance
C++ performance comparison or new host package installation
decisions: This is a scoped application-source constructor contract tested with explicit native doubles, not full native application acceptance; actual native package type-check is also required.
